Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 129. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 20 ki
Casting Time: When you take the attack Action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: For the duration of the Attack Action.
You focus all your power into speed into a series of
fast moving attacks.
For the duration of this technique you gain additional
movement equal to your movement speed and gain an
additional 1d6 damage for each 10 feet you move
between Attack Rolls.
